stock.description: New Gonow Recreational Vehicles, Inc. is an enterprise dedicated to the entire process of custom-built, towable recreational vehicles, from their initial design and development to their manufacture and distribution. The company markets its products under the brand names Snowy River, Regent, and NEWGEN. Established by Xue Zhong Miao on May 17, 2022, its corporate headquarters are located in Jiaxing City, China.
